title: Petra and the Archive
author: D. M. Nystrom
blurb: Elodie Winterbourne, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
